name: Curse of Pain
body:
All existence is pain. You cannot escape it, so use it instead.

Bonus Spells: 0th—shared pain*, 1st—ray of sickening, 2nd—masochism/sadism*, 3rd—terrible remorse, 4th—painwrack*

Curse Manifestation

The lathspell exudes an aura of enhanced pain. Aches feel worse, bruises seem to take longer to heal and their presence never helps with mental anguish. Within 10 feet of the lathspell, all the penalties from spells or effects with the emotion, fear or pain descriptors, or penalties from spells or effects causing the sickened or nauseated conditions are increased by 1.

Additionally, non-lethal damage heals at half the rate it normally does from magical or mundane means.

Curse Abilities
Aggravate Pain (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You can heighten the pain a creature is suffering to debilitate them. As an immediate action you may target a creature that has received hit point damage or nonlethal damage. They must make a Will save.

If they fail, they are sickened for 1d6 rounds and the Will save penalty from the sickened condition is increased to -4. If the damage received is nonlethal or from a critical hit, they take a -4 penalty on the initial Will saving throw and the duration is extended by your Charisma modifier. A critical, nonlethal hit does not stack the Will penalty or duration. If the creature is immune to pain effects or nonlethal damage, they are instead staggered for 1 round. Once a target has been hit with this effect, they are immune to it for 24 hours.

This is a pain effect.

Aura of Mental Trauma (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

You can focus the power of your curse and push it out to cause all creatures within 30 feet of you to have their minds filled with images of past trauma. They must make a Will save or be shaken while within the area of the aura and for 1d6 rounds thereafter. For each round the target remains within the aura, they may make an additional Will save. If they succeed, their condition lessens. If they fail, their condition worsens from shaken to frightened and frightened to panicked. For the frightened and panicked conditions, you are not the focus of their fear so they will not run. For frightened, they will continue to act normally albeit at the heightened condition, and panicked they will only cower. If the creature succeeds at the Will save to reduce their condition when only shaken, they continue to be shaken for 1d6 rounds but no longer need to make additional Will saves.

If the creature is immune to emotion, fear, or mind-affecting effects, they are instead dazed for 1 round upon entering the aura unless they succeed at a Will save. If they succeed on the Will save, they are instead staggered for 1 round.

This is an emotion, fear, mind-affecting effect. Once a creature is no longer affected by the conditions imposed by the aura, they are immune to its effects for 24 hours. You can maintain this aura for up to 1 minute and must spend an equal amount of time with the aura deactivated before you can use it again. Activating or prematurely deactivating the aura is a swift action. It automatically ends after 1 minute with no action.

Crushing Resolve (Su)

You can beat the resolve out of your target. You can demoralize a target you deal damage to via the Intimidate skill as an immediate action. If the target is suffering from your sap willpower curse ability, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus on your Intimidate check.

Ebon Eyes (Sp)

Prerequisite(s) 10th level or higher

You gain the spell eyebite as a spell-like ability usable once per day. You may deliver this spell as part of your cursed strike ability. You gain an additional use at 18th level.

Feeding on Turmoil (Su)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You may choose one creature, excluding yourself, that is suffering from an emotion, fear or pain effect, and gain a morale bonus equal to the penalty suffered by the creature as an immediate action.

The bonuses are applied to the same abilities, attack, damage, checks or skills to which the target is suffering penalties. This bonus lasts for 1 minute or until the creature is no longer suffering penalties or is no longer within the radius. Once a creature has been a target for the ability, they may not be targeted again for 24 hours.

Mark of Heightened Pain (Su)

You can point at a creature within 30 feet and mark them with an aspect of your curse as a standard action. They must make a Will save and if they fail anytime they receive hit point damage they also take nonlethal damage equal to 1/2 the damage dealt until the end of combat. If the target makes their save or is immune to pain effects or nonlethal damage, they are instead staggered for 1 round. Once a target has been targeted with this effect, they are immune to it for 24 hours. This is a pain effect.

Pain Transference (Su)

You can empower your attacks to transfer your pain to another. Once per round, as one of your attacks during the round, you can deal nonlethal damage to the target, equal to the current hit point damage you are suffering from, as a touch attack. If the creature is immune to pain effects or nonlethal damage, they are instead staggered for 1 round. Once a target has been hit with this effect, they are immune to it for 24 hours.

This is a pain effect.

Revel in the Hurt (Ex)

Prerequisite(s) 6th level or higher

You have grown used to constant pain in your life. When reduced to below half of your maximum hit points, or subject to the effects of pain, emotion or fear effect, you can gain the benefits of the heroism spell for 10 minutes as an immediate action. At 12th level, you gain the effects of greater heroism instead. Once you activate this ability, you must wait 1 hour before using it again.

Sap Willpower (Su)

As a standard action during your round, you can sap the willpower and resolve from a target. One target within 30 feet of you must make a Will save, if they fail, they suffer a -2 penalty to Will saves and a -4 on saves vs. emotion and fear effects for 1 minute. If they succeed, they suffer a -1 penalty to Will saves and -2 on saves vs. emotion and fear effects for 1 round. Once a creature is affected by this ability, they are immune to the effect for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting effect.

If using the despair rules, you add the following to the following curse abilities:

Aura of mental trauma imposes the doubting condition initially, then the despairing and finally hopeless conditions instead of the shaken, frightened, panicked conditions. Additionally, it is no longer a fear effect. Instead it is considered a despair effect.
Crushing resolve can also be used to induce despair instead of demoralize.
Ebon eyes can also be used to impose the hopeless condition through the eyebite spell instead of the panicked condition, chosen when the spell-like ability is cast.
Feeding on turmoil can be used on creatures suffering from despair effects.
Revel in hurt also can trigger due to despair effects.
Sap willpower also grants an increased penalty against despair effects.

Additionally, for the walking curse, on page 14, replace shaken with despairing on Table 2-2: Nexus of Pain Conditions and the effect is a despair effect instead of a fear effect in that case.

Walking Curse
Nexus of Pain (Su)

You have been a purveyor and reveler of pain for so long that it infuses every part of your being. Targets are no longer immune to your curse abilities for 24 hours, however, you must wait 1d4 rounds before they can be affected again. Additionally you gain an agonizing gaze attack that can be activated as a standard action.

You may target one creature within 60 feet. They must make a Will save or be affected by a random pain or trauma. The conditions below will not heighten similar conditions, if applicable, but last for a 1d6 plus your Charisma modifier rounds, unless otherwise noted.

Table: Nexus of Pain Condition
d6	Condition
1	Sickened
2	Shaken
3	Dazed (for 1 round only)
4	1d4 persistent nonlethal damage
5	staggered
6	Stunned (for 1 round only)

The agonizing gaze remains active for 1 minute.

During that time any creature within 60 feet that can see you must make the save against your gaze attack or be subject to its effects at the beginning of its turn (see gaze attacks, in the Bestiary, for more information). While under a condition imposed by the gaze, they are immune to it until the condition is removed or its duration expires. The gaze can be ended as a free action on your turn.

This is a mind-affecting, emotion, pain and/or fear effect depending upon the condition. If the creature is immune to the condition or damage rolled, they are instead staggered for 1 round.
